extraction.Name: Louisa Cutschall formerly Louisa Ross
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not at that time but I later told Supt. McGregor about 1922 or 23 that I did not want it, but he said that as long as I had kept it so long there would be no use in trying to get it back.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: No, I had to sell it in order to pay taxes.
extraction.NOTES: Got a Ford Sedan at $600 which was deducted from the sale price of $3000 (including the mortgage); settled some taxes with purchaser at time of sale; two children dependent upon her; does not remember signing a receipt for the patent; notarized May 7, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32; document reference Q210e4 2.
